assertion_refresh_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T_WC_T2S_SERIE.ID_SERIE FROM T_WC_T2S_SERIE JOIN T_WC_T2S_SERIE_GENRE ON T_WC_T2S_SERIE.ID_SERIE = T_WC_T2S_SERIE_GENRE.ID_SERIE WHERE T_WC_T2S_SERIE_GENRE.ID_GENRE = 16 ORDER BY T_WC_T2S_SERIE.NUMBER_OF_SEASONS DESC LIMIT 15
